rateDefinition: Complete-cycle mean physical net local production minus consumption, including item inventory scale, before shipments. Intensity is normalized by the network volume multiplier before station size: High >= 0.8, Medium >= 0.4, Low < 0.4. All rates are full-cycle means, not instantaneous balance.
